note: TGN1412 was developed for rheumatoid arthritis and B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukaemia; the failure came in its first-in-human study.

safety.note: Macaques tolerated a 500-fold margin; all six volunteers had cytokine storm. Human memory T cells carry CD28, the monkeys' do not.
safety.short: Clean in macaques; cytokine storm in all 6

safety.note: Antibody bound to a surface and presented to human white cells reproduced the cytokine release.
